# Public attachment-ingestion fixtures

These files were downloaded unchanged from public research repositories. They are small evaluation fixtures, not a production OCR training set and not synthetic files generated by TicketSense.

## System log

- File: `loghub/HDFS_2k.log`
- Upstream: <https://github.com/logpai/loghub/blob/master/HDFS/HDFS_2k.log>
- Content: 2,000 Hadoop Distributed File System log lines
- Terms: freely available for research or academic work; cite Loghub and review its repository terms
- SHA-256: `7c967000980c086ed55fa6544ba4f05fe66d44622795e890c68caf8bbb635035`

The adjacent `loghub/UPSTREAM_README.md` preserves the upstream HDFS description and citations.

## Screenshot

- File: `gb82-sc/terminal.png`
- Upstream: <https://github.com/imazen/codec-corpus/blob/main/gb82-sc/terminal.png>
- Original collection: GB82 Screen Content Dataset
- License: CC0 1.0; the downloaded upstream license is stored at `gb82-sc/LICENSE`
- SHA-256: `1c9deabfbe43dfff391123ea0f008ab08d75e19da4a0dad59af521ccce2a1beb`

The screenshot can exercise file upload, preview and OCR plumbing. It does not demonstrate that TicketSense has trained or validated a production-quality OCR model.
